name: Mount Healy Overlook
why: Up through spruce and tundra from the park entrance to a rock outcrop over the Nenana River valley, the Alaska Range beyond.
book: No permit. Park entrance fee. Start at the Denali Visitor Center; free shuttles in the entrance area.
water: Water at the visitor centre; none on the trail.
dangers: Moose and grizzly bears: bear spray, make noise.
Snow and wind above the trees out of summer.
Past the overlook the ridge to the true summit is exposed: people have died in falls.
turnaround: The trail ends at the overlook: go further only with mountain experience.
